name: Beggar
ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
interaction: During the day a dead player may announce they give their vote token to the Beggar; the Storyteller moves the token and privately tells the Beggar the donor's alignment.
drunk_or_poisoned: The Beggar cannot be drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: Without a vote token the Beggar cannot vote; each vote spends one token.
Only dead players can give their token, only to the Beggar, and only themselves; the donor loses their vote.
The Beggar can still nominate and vote for exiles, which abilities do not affect.
If the Beggar dies they get one dead vote token and lose all collected tokens.
A donating Recluse may register as evil (wiki example).

test_scenarios.name: cannot vote without token
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Beggar (no tokens), Bob Imp nominated.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: vote on Bob; Alice raises her hand.

test_scenarios.name: donation reveals alignment
test_scenarios.actions: Day 4: Bob gives Alice his token; Alice votes on a nomination.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob is good; her vote counts and spends the token; Bob has no vote token.

test_scenarios.name: Recluse donor
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller may tell Alice that Bob is evil.

test_scenarios.name: dies losing tokens
test_scenarios.expected: Alice has exactly one dead vote token.

test_scenarios.name: immune to poison
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Beggar, Carol Poisoner, Dave dead Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Carol targets Alice. Day 3: Dave donates.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is not poisoned and learns Dave is good.
